credentials.title: Found your Panasonic doorphone
credentials.description:
Detected base unit `{base_model}` at `{base_ip}` (MAC `{base_mac}`).

Enter the **base login password** you set on the base unit's own menu (Menu → Settings → Network → Base login password).

You'll press the pair button on the base on the next screen.

data_description.base_login_password: The password you set on the base unit itself, NOT your VIANA / cloud password.
data_description.display_name: How this doorphone shows up in HA. Becomes the prefix on entity names.

pair.title: Press the pair button on your doorphone
pair.description:
Walk to your Panasonic base unit and **press and hold the pair confirmation button** until it enters pair mode (you'll usually hear a tone or see a flashing light).

When you've pressed it, click Submit below — Home Assistant will negotiate with the base for up to a minute.

error.pair_failed: Pairing failed unexpectedly. Check the daemon log: `docker logs viana-ha` (or `journalctl -u viana-ha`).
error.pair_timeout: Didn't see the pair button get pressed in time. Try again — give yourself enough time to walk to the base.
error.wrong_password: The base login password was rejected. Double-check the value you set on the base's own menu.
error.no_base_on_lan: No Panasonic base answered on this network. Make sure the base is powered, on the same LAN, and in pair mode.

abort.already_configured: This doorphone is already set up.
abort.daemon_missing: The viana-ha daemon discovery file isn't in place yet. Wait for the deploy workflow to finish, then try again.
abort.daemon_unreachable: Couldn't reach the viana-ha daemon. Check that the `viana-ha` container/service is running.
abort.no_base_on_lan: No Panasonic base answered on this LAN. Make sure your doorphone base is powered and reachable from Home Assistant.
